## 〈 Who We Are 〉

> *"The best way to predict the future is to engineer it."*

The **GCET IoT Club** is the premier hardware and embedded systems engineering collective at **Geethanjali College of Engineering and Technology (UGC Autonomous)**. We are not a seminar club. We are not a study group. **We are builders.**

From writing bare-metal `C++` for ESP32 dual-core processors at 240MHz, to deploying **quantized 8-billion-parameter LLMs running entirely offline on local Apple Silicon** — we design and ship complete, production-grade hardware-to-AI systems. Every project we touch has real firmware, real data pipelines, and real impact.

## 〈 Engineering Domains 〉

<div align="center">

| 〔⚡〕Embedded & Firmware | 〔📡〕IoT Cloud & Mesh | 〔🧠〕Edge AI & LLMs | 〔🛠️〕Hardware & PCB |
|:---|:---|:---|:---|
| ESP32 dual-core (240MHz) | MQTT broker mesh networks | Quantized LLMs on Apple MLX | KiCad schematic & PCB layout |
| I²C / SPI / UART / CAN | LoRaWAN long-range (<15km) | TinyML sensor classification | SolidWorks 3D enclosure design |
| FreeRTOS real-time tasks | WebSocket + SSE telemetry | Offline RAG with ChromaDB | Power budget & LiPo management |
| Bare-metal `C/C++` drivers | Node-RED visual pipelines | DoRA fine-tuning on-device | 3D printing & rapid prototyping |
| STM32 / AVR register-level | REST + MQTT bridge gateways | RBAC data security layer | Circuit simulation & analysis |

</div>
